title: Causal Machine Learning: A Survey and Open Problems

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed studies using causal mediation analysis to locate biased model components by intervening on gendered terms, path-specific counterfactual fairness, and counterfactual data augmentation.
Reviewed studies evaluating algorithmic fairness using counterfactual fairness criteria and proxy variables to mitigate unobserved confounding related to race/ancestry.
Reviewed studies measuring counterfactual token fairness by observing the change in toxicity classification outputs when substituting tokens associated with sexual orientation.
